name: Slot marks sample
description: Ui.Inventory sample: Ctrl+click a slot in the backpack or a chest to ask the server to mark the item red (the game does not pick it up; the server checks the item is yours), Alt+right-click to list it, a tint on every stack of 50 or more, and a 'Count this chest' panel beside storage chests that the server answers after checking the chest is near you.
